headline: 'Need to Speed Up': Multiple Calls for Additional Rate Hikes at BOJ July Meeting
summary: The Bank of Japan released the main opinions from its July 30–31 policy meeting. Several members called for early rate hikes, saying the timing of additional hikes needs to speed up.
why: The Bank of Japan sets Japan's short-term policy rate, which influences government bond yields, the yen and global carry-trade flows.
